visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women with long, flowing dark hair perform a synchronized dance routine in a bright, white minimalist studio. One woman wears a metallic purple crop top with a white pleated miniskirt, while the other wears an identical outfit in blue. They execute rhythmic hand gestures and hip movements against a background of arched niches lit with soft purple and blue neon glows. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor bedroom where the two women sit on a bed. They look into the camera with frustrated facial expressions, touching their hair and gesturing towards perceived dryness and tangles. (3) A product showcase appears with bottles of myO2 shampoo displayed against a vibrant purple background with Japanese and Chinese text overlays. (4) Close-up shots show the women holding individual bottles, smiling and winking at the camera to indicate their choice. (5) High-detail shots follow, showing transparent liquid being pumped into hands, followed by white foam being massaged into dark hair and rinsed. (6) A split-screen comparison displays one woman's hair before and after treatment, showing a clear shift from frizzy to smooth. (7) The women return to the studio, dancing with higher energy and tossing their hair frequently to demonstrate its shine and movement.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic pop music starts immediately with a heavy 4/4 beat and bright synth melodies. A female vocalist sings energetic English phrases. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the music ducks for a sequence of conversational Traditional Chinese speech. The two female voices sound youthful and concerned, discussing hair tangles. (3) A new 'ding' sound effect introduces a professional female narrative voiceover, delivering product benefits with high pitch and enthusiastic energy. (4) Distinctive 'pop' and 'water splash' SFX are layered over the narrator as hair washing is depicted. (5) The music swells back to full volume for the closing dance segment, featuring dense percussive electronic hits synced with the editing cuts, ending with a final chime sound.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote myO2 shampoo by using popular influencers to demonstrate a solution for frizzy or flat hair through a blend of entertainment and product tutorial.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of myO2 shampoo bottles, verbal endorsement of product series, and before-and-after visual evidence.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced social media ad utilizing influencer dance trends and clear educational infographics to appeal to a young, beauty-conscious audience.
